description:
Read one marketplace match by id, including its `escrow_terms` and this trade's typed fee/timeout
    fields. You must be a party to the match. Bearer required. `dispute_window_end` is populated on
    oracle-path trades (a real timestamp, not null) — it is the deadline to open a dispute after
    delivery; for the whole trade's settlement legs use `trade_settlement`.
name: market_match
